# IInfiniFiGateway
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/infinifi/IInfiniFiGateway.sol)

**Title:**
IInfiniFiGateway

Interface for InfiniFi's Gateway contract

The InfiniFiGatewayV2 contract provides user-facing functions to interact with the InfiniFi protocol
InfiniFi Architecture:
- USDC can be minted to iUSD (InfiniFi's USD stablecoin)
- iUSD can be staked to siUSD (yield-bearing staked token)
- The Gateway provides convenience functions to handle these flows
Deployed at: 0xd04b37f673c42baa46923fe74a830bae721fb41f


## Functions
### mint

Mint iUSD from USDC


```solidity
function mint(address _to, uint256 _amount) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive iUSD|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|Amount of USDC to deposit|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of iUSD minted (receipt tokens)|


### mintAndStake

Mint iUSD from USDC and stake to siUSD in one transaction


```solidity
function mintAndStake(address _to, uint256 _amount) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive siUSD shares|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|Amount of USDC to deposit|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of iUSD minted (which gets staked)|


### unstake

Unstake siUSD to receive iUSD


```solidity
function unstake(address _to, uint256 _stakedTokens) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive iUSD|
|`_stakedTokens`|`uint256`|Amount of siUSD to unstake|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of iUSD received (receipt tokens)|


### redeem

Redeem iUSD for USDC


```solidity
function redeem(address _to, uint256 _amount, uint256 _minAssetsOut) external returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive USDC|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|Amount of iUSD to redeem|
|`_minAssetsOut`|`uint256`|Minimum amount of USDC to receive (slippage protection)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of USDC received|
